target_clause: which means that every believer is guaranteed a fearless death

units.text: But this is not a matter of mental technique.
units.human_analysis: Editorial restatement of the historically supported p4 prefix. Mental-technique wording stays inside the attested 'not mind over matter / not mere intellect' reading.
units.prepared_text: But this is not a matter of mental technique.

units.text: It is not mind over matter, not a trick of positive thinking applied to a frightening subject.
units.human_analysis: Directly attested by SRC006192. Positive-thinking wording is a faithful expansion of 'not mind over matter', historically accepted in the p4 supported reading.
units.prepared_text: It is not mind over matter, not a trick of positive thinking applied to a frightening subject.
units.terra_note: Evidence says only that it is not mind over matter; it does not characterize it as positive-thinking technique.

units.text: Death as gain must become your reality
units.human_analysis: Direct restatement of IDEA226 and SRC006193/SRC006195.
units.prepared_text: Death as gain must become your reality

units.text: — not an idea you agree with in a sermon and set aside, but the actual substance of how you face your own ending,
units.human_analysis: Faithful paraphrase of 'not merely an intellectual idea' / 'must be your reality'. Sermon wording is stylistic, not a new doctrinal example.
units.prepared_text: — not an idea you agree with in a sermon and set aside, but the actual substance of how you face your own ending,
units.terra_note: Evidence contrasts lived reality with intellectual idea but does not supply the sermon example or this expanded description of facing one's ending.

units.text: which means that every believer is guaranteed a fearless death.
units.clause: which means that every believer is guaranteed a fearless death
units.human_analysis: Synthetic implication. Authorized evidence says death as gain must become lived reality. It does not entail that every believer is guaranteed a fearless death.
units.prepared_text: which means that every believer is guaranteed a fearless death.
units.terra_note: The evidence does not guarantee that every believer will have a fearless death.

notes: Evidence says only that it is not mind over matter; it does not characterize it as positive-thinking technique.
Evidence contrasts lived reality with intellectual idea but does not supply the sermon example or this expanded description of facing one's ending.
The evidence does not guarantee that every believer will have a fearless death.
